input.objective: SITE v3 for Marginalia (continue the v2 site delivered by job d89b2921; keep its stack, look, runtime manifest, review posture, scoreboard, receipts index, duels, share cards, seal page and agent docs; change what is listed here). THE JOB OF THIS VERSION: make it read as an app a trader would use, not a ledger a reader would study. The product in one line: Trade it. Say why. The chain keeps the receipt. AUDIENCE: the average crypto trader on a phone. Knows what a swap box is, holds WETH or IMD, follows callers on X, has been shilled before, does not read documentation. The first screen must look like a swap they have used before, with one extra line: why. Writers who want to argue at length are the second screen, not the first. Voice: product, imperative, short; dry; no slang, no exclamation marks, no promises of returns. 1. THE TRADE BOX IS THE HOME SCREEN. Above the fold, before the scoreboard: a swap-style box that calls router.tradeAndNote(XTrade x, NoteParams p, PoolKey v4Key, uint256 imdIn, uint256 minMargOut, uint256 deadline). Flow: (a) TOKEN: paste or pick X; the site resolves its deepest valid venue automatically (v3/v2 from the canonical factories quoted in WETH or IMD, or a hookless v4 pool) and shows the venue's liquidity; (b) TRADE: amount in, paid in WETH or IMD (the router pulls ERC-20s by transferFrom; native ETH is not accepted, so if the wallet holds ETH but no WETH show a one-tap 'Wrap ETH' step via WETH.deposit); buying X sets the call's side to BUY, selling X (tokenIn = X) sets SELL; show the expected X received/spent from a quote against the venue and set minOut with 1% slippage; (c) TARGET: presets +25% / +50% / 2x / -25% / -50% and a horizon preset 1d / 7d / 30d, editable; (d) WHY: one line, 280 bytes, the X status URL convention for receipts; (e) CONVICTION: a slider for the bond, 0.25 to 10 IMD, labeled 'conviction: returned if you are right, forfeited if not'; (f) COST LINE: 'you pay <X-side amount> + <imdIn> IMD (0.1 stamp + 0.25 MARG, which you keep + bond) ≈ $…'; (g) ONE BUTTON: 'Trade and post', preceded by the needed approvals (the X-side token to the router for exactly amountIn, IMD to the router for exactly imdIn; if paying for X in IMD, a single combined approval). XTrade encoding: kind 1 v4 (key + zeroForOne), 2 v3 (pool + tokenIn), 3 v2 (pool + tokenIn), amountIn, minOut. The resulting note is class Traded: show a 'position proven by the swap' badge on its card. 2. CHECKPOINT WITHOUT FRICTION. The venue still needs a checkpoint 1 to 6 hours old at post time. When the user picks a token whose venue has no live window, the site offers to checkpoint it immediately (gas only), starts a countdown on the box, saves the draft locally, and says in one sentence why ('your baseline is the hour of price history before you, not the moment you click'); if the window is live, say 'ready' and nothing else. The trade-and-post button enables when the window is at least 1 hour old. 3. THE OTHER TWO WAYS, as tabs on the same box, in this order: 'Trade and post' (default) · 'Just the call' (router.note, for a position already held or a view without a trade; keep v2's guided steps) · 'Write a thesis' (long form, targetBps 0), introduced by the line 'Feeling strongly? Add a long-form thesis and compete for the week's pot.' with the week's prize in IMD and dollars beside it and the child-call requirement in one sentence. 4. DOLLARS EVERYWHERE, INFORMATIONAL. The deployment ships no USD oracle, so use the Uniswap v3 IMD/USDC pool at 0x894D4e6d3d2A... (resolve it through the v3 factory 0x1F98431c8aD98523631AE4a59f267346ea31F984 getPool(IMD, USDC 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48, fee) and read slot0 or a short TWAP via the pool's observe) as the IMD/USD reference, labeled 'informational, from the IMD/USDC pool', and show every IMD amount on the site with its dollar equivalent beside it: costs, bonds, the prize, pools, settle prices of IMD-quoted venues (for WETH-quoted venues multiply through the hub). Never use it for anything that settles. 5. CARDS AND SCOREBOARD STAY, below the box: the prize and clock, the leaderboard, open duels, receipts index, verdicts strip, feed; the three reasons move to the About page. Add the Traded badge and the venue liquidity to note cards. 6. COPY. Home tagline under the box: 'Trade it. Say why. The chain keeps the receipt.' Keep the hold-rule sentence on the post flow ('an upward call's wallet must hold through the horizon or forfeit its bond; this binds the posting wallet, not every wallet the author owns'), the disclaimer, and no word 'buy' outside the trade box's own controls. OUT OF SCOPE for v3: the page market screens (next continue, once MarginaliaPages is deployed). REVIEW BRIEF for the review steps, as in v1/v2 plus: approvals only to the router (the X-side token for exactly amountIn, IMD for exactly imdIn) and to WETH for its own deposit, nothing else; the trade quote must be computed client-side from the venue's state, no third-party quote API; the USD reference must be read from the pool named above and labeled informational; the receipts parser must never treat a cited handle as the author; no external scripts. Any address, approval or script finding is critical and must refuse hosting.

_check.note: SITE v3: TRADE-FIRST home (router.tradeAndNote swap box: token → trade → target presets → why → conviction slider → one button; Traded badge), frictionless checkpoint, tabs for just-the-call and thesis, USD everywhere from the IMD/USDC v3 pool (informational). Parent = the v2 site job. Page-market screens = v4 after the Pages launch.
